label: Late in episode, D1 candidate drops after reaching S2, most when S2 was rewarded.
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_common == 0) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state==2) * (prev_common == 0) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == D1) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) * (tv("state",-2)==2) ;; (phase == D1) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) * (tv("reward",-2)==1)
explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 46 sits near 1 and falls steeply in the last episode deciles (timing R^2 0.70). Beyond timing, the variance is almost all at D1 and grows roughly exponentially with episode trial: the dip is deeper when the previous trial reached S2 (biggest after rewarded S2, i.e. the reward input with S2 shown last), and smaller/raised after reaching S1. Plain prev-trial indicators without the late-episode scaling get only ~0.10; the exp(ep_trial/10) envelope is essential. The free fit adds rare-transition terms, a D2 state==S2 dip, and the trial-before state/reward (0.376 dev vs 0.323 short). Belief and choice/policy cues add little; GO and D2 residuals are tiny. Profile ceiling for additive cues is only 0.23 since it lacks the episode-time interaction.
